name: mpdantic
description: Audits and repairs a music library for MPD: output buffer sizing by RAM, .mpdignore management, CUE sheet repair, playlist rebasing, tag validation. Rust core, thin Node shell.
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Pedantic about your library, so MPD does not choke on it. Audits and repairs a music library for MPD, folder by folder, from its own management page.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.1.0 The skeleton: the core, the shell, the build and the signed release pipeline. Nothing to use yet.
